Entering 2026, the Company publicly described the year as a potentially transformative, catalyst-rich year, with topline data from the Phase 3 SENTRY trial in myelofibrosis expected in March 2026 and topline data from the Phase 3 XPORT-EC-042 trial in endometrial cancer expected in mid-2026, and disclosed that its existing liquidity—approximately $64 million of cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash, and investments as of December 31, 2025—was expected to fund operations only into the second quarter of 2026.
